property_summary: Once the contract is initialized, calling SetMinSum must revert and leave MinSum unchanged; the mutant assigns MinSum before the require, so a post-initialization call alters MinSum.

After any call to SetMinSum, MinSum must equal the argument if the call succeeded and must remain at its previous value if the call reverted; the mutant writes MinSum before the require, so a reverting (post-initialization) call still changes MinSum.
Once the contract is Initialized, a SetMinSum call must revert and leave MinSum at its pre-initialization value; the mutant writes MinSum before the require, so a reverting call overwrites MinSum.

Once Initialized() has been called, any further SetMinSum call must revert and leave MinSum at its pre-initialization value; the mutant writes MinSum=_val before the require, so a reverting post-initialization call alters MinSum.

After initialization, SetMinSum can no longer raise MinSum, so a user whose balance covers the original MinSum can always Collect it; the mutant lets post-init SetMinSum overwrite MinSum, making Collect silently fail and leaving the balance untouched.
Once the contract is Initialized(), calling SetMinSum must have no effect on MinSum; the buggy version lets SetMinSum overwrite MinSum even after initialization.
A deposit of amount must succeed and increase the depositor's recorded balance to exactly amount.
